{{Top|leg}}
The '''Silent Voices''' were luminescent bands of gases that glowed in the [[Anzat/Legends|Anzat]] atmosphere at night. Ancient [[Anzat (species)|Anzati]] believed that these were the life essences of their ancestors. Although such a possibility was not scientifically viable, it illustrated the level of importance that "[[Soup (Anzati)|soup]]" played in Anzati culture, morals, and belief structures.
